findings.highlight: Holding Saber, I look at the building with blank amazement
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves from Shirou naming the ruin directly to Rin explaining Archer selected it as an emergency refuge.
findings.explanation: The English conditionally inserts unsupported narration about holding Saber, staring blankly, and the building becoming a desolate ruin.

findings.governingReading: Rin says Archer found the ruin on the way in for use as an emergency hideout.
findings.explanation: The English conditionally adds a separate line about Rin’s nerves and her entering the ruin, material absent from the bound Japanese page.

findings.highlight: The building seems like a corpse desecrated by the forest
findings.evidenceJa: 廃墟は木々に浸食されていた
findings.governingReading: The ruin is being encroached upon by the trees, after which the source identifies its usable portion and moonlit room.
findings.explanation: The English conditionally inserts rubble, abandonment, collapse, and corpse-desecration prose not present in the bound Japanese witness.

findings.highlight: The only usable rooms are on the second floor, and this is the best of those
findings.governingReading: Only part of the second floor is usable as a room.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the usable rooms and invents a comparison declaring this one the best.

findings.highlight: I can see the night sky from here
findings.evidenceJa: 強い月光が室内を照らしていた
findings.governingReading: Strong moonlight illuminates the interior through the miraculously surviving windows.
findings.explanation: Seeing the night sky replaces the stated illumination and obscures the unusual way moonlight reaches the room.

findings.governingReading: Rin dusts off the bed positioned against a wall.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the bed specifically beside the window.

findings.governingReading: Rin briefly judges Archer as affected, theatrical, or impossibly suave to the end.
findings.explanation: Arrogant replaces performative stylishness with personal superiority, hardening her compressed elegiac assessment.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka murmurs as if laughing off a bad rumor
findings.governingReading: After Rin’s short remark, silence falls.
findings.explanation: The English conditionally inserts a gloss that prescribes her delivery and likens Archer’s fate to a bad rumor.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーはここで倒す
findings.governingReading: Rin resolves that, having lost Archer, they will defeat Berserker here.
findings.explanation: Get Berserker here can mean bringing him to the ruin and fails to state her decision to defeat him.

findings.highlight: punching her left hand with her right
findings.evidenceJa: 左手を右拳に打ち付ける
findings.governingReading: Rin strikes her open left hand against her right fist to break the silence.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the moving and receiving hands, making the right fist punch the left hand.

findings.governingReading: Rin declares that this is as far as she will indulge regret.
findings.explanation: Mourning narrows the emotion to bereavement and presents Archer’s death as the sole object rather than her broader regret.

findings.highlight: Anything that fights him will die
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that if they fight Berserker, they will die.
findings.explanation: Anything universalizes a desperate assessment of their party’s situation into an absolute property applying to every possible opponent.

findings.governingReading: Shirou rebukes himself for the half-awake or foolish line of thought that Rin claims she can win.
findings.explanation: What am I saying turns silent internal correction into a comment on words he spoke.

findings.evidenceJa: 一定量の魔力さえ補充
findings.governingReading: If Saber receives a sufficient specified quantity of magical energy, she can again exercise her former ability.
findings.explanation: Replenish her stocks omits the threshold quantity and can suggest filling her reserves generally or completely.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィールの庭の中
findings.governingReading: They are inside Illya’s controlled territory or garden in the broad sense of her domain.
findings.explanation: Yard makes the bounded magical territory sound like the ordinary grounds immediately around a house.

findings.highlight: there may be someone other than Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: 人の魂なんかどこにもない
findings.governingReading: Rin says there are no human souls anywhere here, then continues that someone else may nevertheless be inside the castle.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “here” directly into “there” across a control marker, damaging the pivot between the two clauses.

findings.highlight: going there to look is like going to die
findings.evidenceJa: みすみす死地に赴くようなもの
findings.governingReading: Going back to search the castle would mean knowingly walking into a place of death.
findings.explanation: Like going to die weakens the deliberate entry into a lethal zone and produces awkward English.

findings.highlight: There is one more method other than the sharing magic
findings.evidenceJa: それ以外にわずかな方法しかない
findings.governingReading: Only a small number of methods besides shared magic can transfer magical energy to a Servant.
findings.explanation: The English changes an unspecified few alternatives into exactly one additional method, altering the system claim.

findings.governingReading: Saber’s recovery requires reopening and routing the incomplete path in a complete form.
findings.explanation: Correct the path removes both the complete-form requirement and the act of running the connection anew.

findings.highlight: We just need to reconnect the spiritual path
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎とセイバーを共感状態にして
findings.governingReading: Rin must first place Shirou and Saber into a state of shared empathy or resonance, then reconnect the spiritual path.
findings.explanation: The English omits the required shared state entirely and presents reconnection as the only operation.

findings.highlight: I can give that magic circuit to someone else
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路を、自分以外に分け与える
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese ends after defining circuits as a magus’s core and value; the question about sharing one is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores a deleted internal question as active narration.

findings.evidenceJa: 死にいく人の体に移しても
findings.governingReading: Even transplanting a Heroic Spirit’s circuit into the body of a dying person would produce only a severe rejection reaction.
findings.explanation: Transplanted on uses the wrong preposition and makes the already technical explanation difficult to parse.

findings.highlight: we won’t be able to survive
findings.evidenceJa: 誰も生き残ることは出来ない
findings.governingReading: Rin says no one will be able to survive unless they take this measure.
findings.explanation: We narrows the absolute stake from everyone involved to the immediate party.

findings.highlight: removing the part of my nerves
findings.governingReading: Loss of a circuit gouges away part of the self or spirit and damages the integrity of the spiritual body.
findings.explanation: The English turns this spiritual mutilation into removal of an unspecified part of Shirou’s nerves.

findings.highlight: The essential parts are written in the blueprint
findings.evidenceJa: 必要不可欠なパーツとして設計図には画かれている
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese proceeds from the circuit loss directly to the impossibility of becoming complete; the blueprint analogy is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores the deleted analogy as active narration.

findings.highlight: My hope of becoming complete will disappear here
findings.evidenceJa: 未熟でも経験をつめば一人前になれる
findings.governingReading: The ordinary hope is that even an immature magus can accumulate experience and become fully fledged.
findings.explanation: The English omits accumulated experience and professional maturation, replacing them with an abstract hope of completeness.

findings.governingReading: Without the foundational circuit, Emiya Shirou will remain only half a magus however he struggles.
findings.explanation: Incomplete loses the social and professional judgment of remaining permanently half-fledged.

findings.highlight: eyes look as if they’re in regret
findings.governingReading: Saber’s lowered eyes appear submerged in regret despite her neutral verbal assent.
findings.explanation: Eyes in regret is malformed English and weakens the visual metaphor.

findings.highlight: I don’t know how from the first place
findings.evidenceJa: そんな魔術式を知らない
findings.governingReading: Shirou does not know a magical formula or procedure of this kind, so Rin must handle the preparation.
findings.explanation: The English omits the magical formula and produces an ungrammatical generic statement.

findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to keep his circuit on while keeping his own mind as steady as possible.
findings.explanation: Getting disturbed makes him a passive recipient and weakens the deliberate mental control required.

findings.governingReading: They must maximize bodily contact and minimize intervening barriers such as clothing.
findings.explanation: Screening is the wrong English term for material separation between their bodies.

findings.governingReading: Rin tells Saber not to put on a brave front when even raising an arm is painful.
findings.explanation: Don’t say that removes Rin’s diagnosis of Saber’s habitual show of strength.

findings.governingReading: Shirou folds the shirt meticulously to distract or fool himself out of his nervousness.
findings.explanation: Hide my nervousness suggests concealing it from the others rather than managing his own tension.

findings.highlight: how hard the transplant of the Magic Circuit is
findings.evidenceJa: その成否がどれだけ難しい
findings.governingReading: Shirou confronts how difficult successful completion is, as well as the loss and pain involved.
findings.explanation: How hard the transplant is shifts the problem from uncertain success to general procedural difficulty.

findings.highlight: The thing I should be scared of is the fight against Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: 真に恐れ抗うべきは、この後に控えるバーサーカーの打倒
findings.governingReading: The true ordeal he must fear and resist is defeating Berserker after this intermediate step.
findings.explanation: The English removes resistance and changes the required defeat into merely the coming fight.

findings.highlight: Saber’s skin is like new-fallen snow, or marble
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの肌は、新雪か、大理石か
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves from Rin’s permission directly to Shirou forgetting to breathe; the snow, marble, open-blouse, and profane-beauty description is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores two deleted eroticized narration lines as active prose.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに覆い被さって
findings.governingReading: Rin directs Shirou to lean over and cover Saber with his body to increase contact.
findings.explanation: Get on top of uses a more sexually loaded and less geometrically precise phrasing.

findings.highlight: I’ll take it until you two sympathize
findings.governingReading: Rin will manage the magical synchronization up to the point when Shirou and Saber resonate.
findings.explanation: Sympathize is a dictionary-near false friend that describes emotional concern rather than magical synchronization.

findings.highlight: Their conversation doesn’t come into my head
findings.evidenceJa: 二人の話し声が、あまり頭に入ってこない
findings.governingReading: Shirou can barely take in what the two are saying because steadying his breathing consumes his attention.
findings.explanation: Doesn’t come into my head copies Japanese phrasing into nonidiomatic English.

findings.evidenceJa: 肌が触れあうほど接近する
findings.governingReading: They draw close enough that their skin touches.
findings.explanation: Almost touching withholds the bodily contact the source states as the threshold already reached.

findings.governingReading: Shirou clears and levels his mind in order to synchronize with Saber.
findings.explanation: Sympathize again substitutes emotional fellow-feeling for the technical magical operation.

findings.highlight: mind is escaping out of my chest
findings.evidenceJa: 胸から前に自我が抜け落ちようとしている
findings.governingReading: Unlike the usual exit through his back, Shirou’s ego now slips out through his chest and forward.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the chest but omits the forward direction essential to the reversed trajectory.

findings.highlight: breathing is starting to become lively
findings.governingReading: Saber’s previously calm breathing begins to quicken and grow uneven.
findings.explanation: Lively gives the breath a cheerful vitality rather than increased respiratory pace.

findings.governingReading: In response to Saber’s bell-like voice, Shirou’s ego fully separates from his body.
findings.explanation: I answer invents a reply and changes the relation from triggered movement to verbal response.

findings.evidenceJa: むき出しのまま走り抜ける
findings.governingReading: Without hands, feet, or even bodily self, the exposed ego races through.
findings.explanation: Naked converts metaphysical exposure into physical nudity.

findings.evidenceJa: 時を逆行するかのような速度
findings.governingReading: The speed feels as though it reverses time.
findings.explanation: Running back in time presents the motion itself as temporal reversal and weakens the explicit simile.

findings.highlight: It rather feels like I’m being left behind
findings.evidenceJa: 翔けているのではなく、置き去りにされているかのような錯覚
findings.governingReading: The sensation is not of soaring forward but the illusion of being left behind by the speed.
findings.explanation: The English retains the latter impression but omits the rejected soaring interpretation that structures the contrast.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s concentrated ego becomes an arrowhead piercing successive boundaries.
findings.explanation: Dart changes the pointed head into a complete projectile and weakens the image of concentrated penetration.

findings.governingReading: Sparks race through the circuit.
findings.explanation: From changes the circuit from the sparks’ path into their point of origin.

findings.governingReading: A compressed life-review or panorama of memories is heavy and therefore cruelly indifferent.
findings.explanation: Concentrated life removes the conventional near-death cascade of remembered scenes.

findings.evidenceJa: 数値化された人体運営
findings.governingReading: The operation of the human body is rendered as quantified data.
findings.explanation: Digitalization of human is both grammatically malformed and conceptually different from visualized bodily operation.

findings.highlight: Several hundred organs are connected using several billion connections
findings.evidenceJa: 幾億の接合が輪を作る
findings.governingReading: Hundreds of mechanisms and hundreds of millions of junctions form rings.
findings.explanation: The English converts junctions into an instrument connecting organs and omits the ring structures they form.

findings.governingReading: In this internal highway, thought passes at the speed of light.
findings.explanation: The English makes present time itself pass, replacing mental processing with chronology.

findings.highlight: owned by the existence called Arturia
findings.governingReading: Beyond the boundary Shirou glimpses magical circuits belonging to the existence Artoria, not Emiya Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English identifies Artoria but omits the explicit contrast with Shirou’s own circuit.

findings.highlight: pain as if squashed by a strong force
findings.evidenceJa: 万力で締められる苦しみ
findings.governingReading: His form slowly sinks as though simmering while suffering the pressure of being tightened in a vise.
findings.explanation: A strong force generalizes the vise, and the English omits the simmering quality of the descent.

findings.governingReading: The new ordeal takes an eternity to descend a single ri, roughly four kilometers.
findings.explanation: Mile substitutes a substantially shorter unit and changes the measured contrast.

findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes that the magical synchronization is functioning correctly.
findings.explanation: Sympathizing again mistakes technical resonance for emotional fellow-feeling.

findings.highlight: I can’t see anywhere in this darkness
findings.governingReading: The darkness provides no view forward or backward along the path.
findings.explanation: Anywhere broadens a directional limitation into complete blindness in all directions.

findings.governingReading: The path had seemed infinite until its end became perceptible.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the earlier impression into a factual property just as the source corrects it.

findings.governingReading: The destination is the mental world at Saber’s center and the source of her magical circuit.
findings.explanation: The English cuts “center” off mid-word.

findings.governingReading: The active Japanese begins with the red lake swirling silently; the standalone absolute-silence line is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores the deleted sentence as active narration.

findings.highlight: I stare at the full scenery
findings.governingReading: Shirou surveys the entire structure from above.
findings.explanation: Stare removes the overhead vantage and uses scenery for the system’s total configuration.

findings.evidenceJa: 静止したガソリンの海
findings.governingReading: The unignited reserve resembles a motionless sea of gasoline.
findings.explanation: Stalled implies failed mechanical progress rather than dormant stillness awaiting ignition.

findings.evidenceJa: 人間が抱く、あらゆる脅威
findings.governingReading: The emerging dragon embodies every form of threat or terror that human beings harbor in imagination.
findings.explanation: Threats to mankind changes human fear into external dangers directed against humanity.

findings.governingReading: The king is a noble or exalted child of the stars who bears phantasmal blood in human form.
findings.explanation: Sacred adds religious holiness in place of nobility or exalted rank.

findings.evidenceJa: 象徴であり畏怖である君臨者
findings.governingReading: The dragon reigns as both symbol and object of awe among the many Phantasmal Species.
findings.explanation: The English makes it “fear” itself and flattens the reigning sovereign construction into an ungrammatical list.

findings.governingReading: The dragon stands among the many Phantasmal Species, a technical category broader than ordinary beasts.
findings.explanation: Beasts narrows the setting term and obscures its taxonomic force.

findings.governingReading: The dragon is Saber’s true nature on a scale outside normal standards, befitting the strongest class.
findings.explanation: Absurd turns exceptional magnitude into ridicule or illogic.

findings.governingReading: The pain goes beyond language, expressed through a sentence itself breaking apart.
findings.explanation: Eradicates all words invents an external act of destruction and reverses the idiom.

findings.highlight: It cannot bear it if it’s alive
findings.evidenceJa: 生きていては耐えられない
findings.governingReading: The grotesque thought is that one could not bear food remaining alive and conscious while it is eaten.
findings.explanation: The English assigns inability to endure to the living food itself, changing experiencer and logic.

findings.highlight: it’s too cruel to keep it alive
findings.evidenceJa: 痛覚があってはあまりにも惨い
findings.governingReading: Food is killed because allowing pain and conscious awareness during consumption would be unbearably cruel.
findings.explanation: The English omits pain and the consciousness ruby, reducing the horror to generic cruelty in keeping food alive.

findings.governingReading: Shirou cries out or gives voice to his suffering.
findings.explanation: Appeal my pain is ungrammatical English.

findings.governingReading: While being chewed and crushed, Shirou begs for mercy like a crucified sinner.
findings.explanation: Bitten on is malformed and weakens pulverizing mastication into a bite.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s consciousness disperses under the overwhelming pain and pressure.
findings.explanation: Senses changes the faculty lost and duplicates an earlier sensory transition instead of marking collapse of consciousness.

findings.governingReading: The image of Saber bowing her head and trusting him to endure this hell comes vividly back to life.
findings.explanation: I recall makes the return a deliberate, flat act of memory and weakens the image’s revivifying force.

findings.highlight: I exhilarate the significance of this anguish
findings.evidenceJa: 苦悶の意義に奮い立った
findings.governingReading: The purpose of the anguish rouses Shirou and restores his resolve.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou act on the abstract significance and uses “exhilarate” transitively in malformed English.

findings.governingReading: Shirou literally and painfully realizes why he came, with 痛感 linking realization to the pain he is undergoing.
findings.explanation: Fully realize conveys intensity but removes the literalized pain wordplay.

findings.highlight: answer the trust she kept many times
findings.evidenceJa: 幾度となく守られた信頼に応える
findings.governingReading: Shirou comes to repay the trust through which Saber has protected him time and again.
findings.explanation: Trust she kept many times is unidiomatic and loses the repeated protection grounding his response.

findings.governingReading: Shirou lacks a method or means of fighting and therefore offers the greatest response still available to him.
findings.explanation: Cannot fight turns absence of a method in this situation into absolute personal incapacity.

findings.governingReading: Shirou neither reaches toward his shattering consciousness nor lets it blur; he sharpens consciousness like a blade.
findings.explanation: The English replaces consciousness with senses twice, breaking the sequence about preserving the self under pain.

findings.highlight: withstand the pain even for an instant
findings.evidenceJa: わずかでも耐えられた
findings.governingReading: If Shirou can withstand even the slightest amount of the pain, his consciousness will never vanish here where eternity is an instant.
findings.explanation: For an instant changes degree into duration and confuses the immediately preceding time paradox.

findings.governingReading: Saber’s finely intricate magical circuit shines in seven colors and begins circulating.
findings.explanation: Delicate suggests fragility rather than dense, precise complexity.

findings.governingReading: Shirou checks his body while consciousness remains uncertain and unsteady after surfacing.
findings.explanation: Dizzy supplies a specific physical sensation instead of the unreliable state of awareness.

findings.highlight: mental wound that could’ve been a trauma
findings.evidenceJa: 後遺症になりかねなかった精神の傷
findings.governingReading: Even the mental wound that might have remained as a lasting aftereffect has healed.
findings.explanation: Could have been a trauma confuses the wound with its possible sequela and produces circular clinical wording.

findings.highlight: The feeling of her soft skin
findings.governingReading: The moist, close sensation of Saber’s skin abruptly clarifies whose voice he hears and their position.
findings.explanation: Soft replaces the specifically moist tactile quality.

findings.evidenceJa: 今がどんな状態なのか
findings.governingReading: The skin contact makes Shirou understand his present bodily situation.
findings.explanation: What we’re doing implies a continuing intentional activity and adds sexual agency to an awakening posture.

findings.evidenceJa: お互い妙に意識してしまって
findings.governingReading: Both have become awkwardly self-conscious about the other and cannot meet eyes.
findings.explanation: Conscious of each other is stiff and can mean mere awareness, weakening the embarrassed attraction.

findings.governingReading: Shirou reaches for the top he meticulously folded to distract himself.
findings.explanation: Extremely folded-up is nonidiomatic and mistakes care or thoroughness for physical degree.

findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls synchronizing with Saber and transplanting the circuit into her depths.
findings.explanation: Sympathized again changes a magical resonance operation into emotional fellow-feeling.

findings.highlight: I can still use the strengthening spell just fine
findings.evidenceJa: 目を閉じて状況を把握する
findings.governingReading: Shirou closes his eyes and takes stock of his internal condition before distinguishing usable Strengthening from overall decline.
findings.explanation: The English omits the deliberate diagnostic action and jumps straight to the result.

findings.highlight: a weak link between Saber and I
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに繋がる微かなライン
findings.governingReading: Shirou senses a faint line connecting him to Saber.
findings.explanation: The object pronoun should be “me”; the sentence is grammatically malformed.

findings.governingReading: The new connection is faint and difficult to locate precisely.
findings.explanation: Weak suggests a deficient or unreliable bond rather than low perceptibility.

findings.highlight: If I was not so useless
findings.governingReading: Saber says that if she had not been so lacking in power, Shirou would not have suffered this cost.
findings.explanation: Useless converts situational insufficiency into wholesale self-condemnation.

findings.highlight: because I couldn’t supply you with magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに迷惑をかけていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the root cause was his inability to supply mana and the burden this had placed on Saber.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the supply failure but omits his recognition that he caused Saber hardship.

findings.highlight: I actually feel better now than when I had it
findings.evidenceJa: 無い方がスッキリする
findings.governingReading: Shirou lightly claims he is better off or less encumbered without circuits he supposedly never used.
findings.explanation: Feel better now can assert improved physical health, obscuring his joking attempt to dismiss the loss.

findings.highlight: we spent the night dressed like that
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls being pressed close to Saber while she was revealingly dressed, and remaining together until morning.
findings.explanation: Spent the night dressed like that removes their bodily contact, which is what drives his renewed embarrassment.

findings.governingReading: Unless Shirou steadies himself, he risks being caught off guard or defeated in the coming battle.
findings.explanation: Make a mistake reduces a potentially fatal combat failure to a generic error.

findings.highlight: she’s like a different person right now
findings.evidenceJa: 別人みたいにぱりっとしない
findings.governingReading: Groggy Rin is so lacking in her usual crisp composure that she seems like another person.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the comparison and omits the concrete character trait being contrasted.

findings.governingReading: Rin wakes, accepts the successful result with “I see—good,” and stands.
findings.explanation: Let’s go invents an immediate departure command.

findings.highlight: on the other side of the silent forest
findings.governingReading: Berserker and Illya wait beyond the silent trees surrounding the refuge.
findings.explanation: Other side of the forest relocates them across the entire woodland rather than somewhere beyond the nearby trees.

findings.highlight: lose many significant things we exchanged
findings.governingReading: Unless they defeat Berserker, even the many meanings created or exchanged during the night will be lost.
findings.explanation: Significant things replaces meanings with unspecified objects or experiences and muddles what was exchanged.
